name: @payswap/surface
description: Framework-independent PaySwap Surface contracts and capability/operation discovery projections (Work Order P2-W3): the five outcome actions (Pay/Receive/Move/Convert/Checkout) with honest dispatchability facts, the eleven operational areas of the navigation IA, the quote/terms disclosure projection (fees, rate provenance, expiry, estimate-vs-guarantee labeling), progress/exception/UNKNOWN state projections (submission is not finality; a payout sent is not beneficiary credit), capability/operation discovery projections, exact integer minor-unit money display with locale data as explicit inputs, and the BLOCK/ALLOW/UNKNOWN security vocabulary folded into people language — typed contracts the Web, Desktop, Mobile, Extension and SDK/API consumers render WITHOUT React, WITHOUT Next.js, WITHOUT any UI framework and with ZERO runtime dependencies (INV-22/INV-23).
